instruction: Put the lightweight bell with smooth surface to the right of the rubikscube for twisting and turning.

source.instruction: Put the lightweight bell with smooth surface to the right of the rubikscube for twisting and turning.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the object, which was at x = -21 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the left gripper over the bell to (-21, -15, 94) and orient it.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+9, +4, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, -15, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the left gripper partially toward the bell to z = 87 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -6) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, -15, 87) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Descend further to grasp height z = 78 cm and close gripper around the bell.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, -15, 79) opening 0.77; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the bell to z = 89 cm before moving it.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, +10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, -15, 88) opening 0.82; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Transport the bell to the right of the rubik's cube around (-6, -1, 89).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+16, +13, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-6, -1, 89) opening 0.82; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the bell to the table surface (z = 81 cm) and release gripper.
